body:
## Summary

In repository mode, `/solve <repository-url> --auto-merge` merged [konard/vietnam-accomodation-search#51](https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/pull/51) with only `Fixes #50`. GitHub closed the combined issue #50, and all 7 issues it lists (#16, #39–#43, #48) stayed open. The full case study, with a timeline, logs and data, is in [`docs/case-studies/issue-2306`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2306-bbb8ab8b914e/docs/case-studies/issue-2306/README.md).

## Root causes and fixes

| # | Root cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| RC1 | 6 of 7 issues could not be attached as sub-issues (`Sub issue may only have one parent (HTTP 422)`): they were still sub-issues of **closed** combined issues from earlier runs (#20, #44). | `attachSubIssues()` reads the current parent (`GET /issues/{n}/parent`). If that parent is closed or is a generated combined issue, it moves the issue with the documented `replace_parent` parameter. An open parent written by a person is kept. |
| RC2 | `--ensure-all-sub-issues-addressed` only checked **native** sub-issues, so it saw #48 and nothing else. | The required set is now native sub-issues ∪ the "Required closing references" block of the combined issue body (`parseRequiredClosingReferences`, `mergeRequiredSubIssues`). |
| RC3 | Missing closing references never blocked `--auto-merge`, even though the AI explicitly withheld them because the work needed operator credentials. | Both auto-merge paths (the watch loop and the one-shot `attemptAutoMerge`) run `checkClosingReferencesBeforeMerge()`. A `missing_closing_references` blocker posts the "auto-merge blocked" comment with the exact `Fixes #N` lines instead of merging. |
| RC4 | The log was uploaded before the post-solve restart loops ran, so two hours of iterations and the merge were never published. | `attachLogAfterPostSolveRestarts()` uploads the log again after the last loop when any loop ran iterations. |

Replaying the real data, the gate reports *"The pull request #51 description does not close 7 of the 7 issue(s) required by #50"*, so that PR would have been left unmerged, with an explanation.

## How to reproduce

`node tests/test-repository-mode-closing-references-2306.mjs` replays the real #50 body and the merged #51 description saved in `docs/case-studies/issue-2306/data/`. On `main` the new helpers do not exist, and nothing stopped the merge.

## Tests

- New: `tests/test-repository-mode-closing-references-2306.mjs` (22 tests). It covers:
  - parsing the real #50 body;
  - the gate on the real #51 description (blocked) and on a fixed description (allowed);
  - comma lists still leaving issues open;
  - `replace_parent` / `/parent` argument builders;
  - moving issues away from closed or generated parents, and keeping a human parent (fake `gh`);
  - the blocked-merge comment;
  - the gate in both merge paths;
  - the log re-upload.
- Updated: `tests/test-solve-repository-mode-2212.mjs` (the parent lookup is a GET, not a retry) and `tests/test-closed-issue-merge-blocking-2144.mjs` (the gate is the union of both blocker sources).
- `npm run lint`, the Prettier check and the default test suite pass locally.

## Docs

- Updated the option description, README, CONFIGURATION and FEATURES in all 4 languages.
- Added a changeset (patch).

## CI: dependency pins

The `detect-changes` job runs `scripts/check-dependency-freshness.mjs`, which fails whenever an upstream release comes out. It failed on this branch with 12 stale pins, none of them related to this change. Following the other open PRs (#2297–#2300), this branch cherry-picks the shared "refresh CI-enforced dependency pins; adapt to command-stream 1.x results" commit and its guard test from #2297. It also bumps the two pins released since then: Formal AI 0.352.1 (no `openssl-sys`, `rust-version = "1.98"` matches the builder) and lint-staged 17.6.0. It fixes one new `result.stderr || result.stdout` fallback in `fetchIssueBody` that the command-stream 1.x guard flagged.

## Overlap with #2300

#2300 (issue #2284) also reclaims closed-parent sub-issues with `replace_parent` (RC1 here), using the same `buildAddSubIssueApiArgs({ replaceParent })` shape. RC2–RC4 exist only in this PR. Whichever PR merges second should keep a single reclaim implementation.

Fixes #2306
title: Require every listed issue to be closed before auto-merging a repository-mode pull request
